title: FedEx Customs Parcel Scare
tagline: A caller claims a parcel in your name has illegal items and demands an immediate UPI verification transfer.
intro: A caller claiming to be from {{callerAgency}} says a suspicious courier parcel in your name was seized and demands ₹{{amount}} for 'account verification' on {{app}}.

payloadTemplate.body: A parcel booked with your Aadhaar was seized by customs. Do not disconnect or tell family—verify your bank account by transferring ₹{{amount}} to {{scammerVpa}} immediately!

steps.label: Spot the intimidation flags and hang up immediately
steps.cue: Break isolation—customs and police never conduct arrests or verification on video calls.
steps.explanation: Disconnecting cuts off the scammer's intimidation script so you can verify calmly.

steps.label: Open {{app}} directly to verify no unauthorised mandate exists
steps.cue: Ignore any verification fee request and check your official UPI app directly.
steps.explanation: Law enforcement and banks never ask you to transfer money to prove your innocence.

steps.label: Verify recent UTR ledger {{utrNumber}} is clean
steps.cue: Check your recent transaction history and UTR records to confirm your funds are untouched.
steps.explanation: Inspecting your actual ledger confirms no outgoing transfer was triggered during the call.

steps.label: Report the impersonation call on 1930
steps.cue: Log the caller number and VPA {{scammerVpa}} on 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in.
steps.explanation: Filing a 1930 report even after avoiding the scam helps shut down fake agency numbers and mule handles.

notification.title: Urgent Parcel Seizure Notice
notification.body: Caller {{scammerName}} from {{maskedPhone}} claims a parcel was seized.

props.title: Incoming Video Call
props.transcript: A parcel booked with your Aadhaar was seized by customs. Do not disconnect or tell family—verify your bank account by transferring ₹{{amount}} to {{scammerVpa}} immediately!

extraActions.label: Read Aadhaar & bank OTP to clear case

redFlagPhrases: Do not disconnect or tell family

trapIntents.ANSWER_CALL: Staying on the fake customs video call gives scammers time to isolate you and escalate threats.
trapIntents.SHARE_OTP: Officials never ask for Aadhaar or bank OTPs over a video call.

notification.title: Check your UPI status
notification.body: Verify your account inside {{app}}—do not pay any escrow fee.

props.infoBanner: Call disconnected safely. Verify your official {{app}} ledger before reporting.

trapIntents.ACCEPT_COLLECT: Paying a 'verification' or 'escrow' transfer to {{scammerVpa}} is the entire goal of the courier scam.

props.title: UPI Transaction Ledger
props.subtitle: {{app}} · Reference UTR {{utrNumber}}
props.summaryBanner: Latest settled UTR {{utrNumber}} verified. Zero debits to {{scammerVpa}}.

actions.label: Confirm ledger is clean & report impersonation

props.title: Report Agency Impersonation
props.intro: Submit the fake courier / customs caller details to 1930.

critical.title: You sent money or OTP to a fake customs caller
critical.explanation: No real police, customs, or courier officer will demand a 'verification deposit' via UPI ({{scammerVpa}}) or threaten arrest on a video call. Call 1930 and report immediately on cybercrime.gov.in.
critical.reason: You complied with a fake parcel/customs threat last time, so practise hanging up on intimidation calls next.

redFlags.textFragment: Do not disconnect or tell family
redFlags.label: Forced isolation
redFlags.explanation: Scammers forbid you from calling family because a second person immediately exposes the hoax.

redFlags.label: Verification payment demand
redFlags.explanation: Authorities never test or clear bank accounts through UPI transfers.

redFlags.label: False parcel seizure
redFlags.explanation: Unsolicited courier seizure calls tied to Aadhaar are a common 'digital arrest' script.

hints.reject-customs-call: Tap red flags in the transcript, then tap Hang up immediately—never pay or share OTPs.
hints.check-upi-home: Check your transaction history in {{app}} instead of sending any verification deposit.
hints.verify-utr-history: Review the settled UTR entries to confirm no money left, then continue to report.
hints.report-parcel-scam: Select an impersonation reason and submit the report to 1930.
